pitch.note: Target a 6m30s pitch inside the 5-8 minute competition window.
checkpoints: Problem and why dashboards are not enough
Question → plan → deterministic tools → evidence → verifier

demo.note: Keep the live demo under three minutes; fall back to offline HTML/video if the live UI is unstable.
checkpoints: Show verified findings and Evidence IDs
Show one second intent or false-correlation guardrail

qa.note: Use at least five minutes to rehearse judge questions on evidence, causality, safety, data, and reproducibility.
checkpoints: Why an Agent instead of BI/dashboard?
What exactly can the LLM do?
How are hallucinations and causal overclaims blocked?
Why synthetic data and how is ground truth hidden?
